verdict.rationale: The GST portal's public help pages offer a step-by-step registration user manual and say users can download or print FAQs and manuals. A due-dates PDF is also posted, and a probe notes the GST portal serves readable pages without a login, so instructions are available without an account. Nothing shows the forms themselves (e.g., blank registration or return forms) can be downloaded, since every module describes filing through the online portal. Missing for 10: evidence that the blank forms themselves are downloadable, explicit confirmation that the manuals and FAQs need no login, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
